each panel's rows and the fields it names that its table does not have.

BoardData.title: BoardData

BoardFilter.title: BoardFilter

is not set keeps every row.

BoardPanel.title: BoardPanel
BoardPanel.description: One panel of a board. Only the fields its kind reads are set.

BoardSelect.title: BoardSelect
BoardSelect.description: What a click on a mark, a row or a node does: param takes that row's field.

A dashboard: tables, controls and linked panels. A control or a click on a panel sets a
param; every panel whose filters name it redraws. No code runs and nothing is fetched but
louped's own data, so a board is safe to show and to commit.

unset.
